title: fix(app-shell): a deleted record leaves the recently-accessed list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97evQ69Yx3njz2MqoYASHxL)_
Fixes #33826

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除记录成功后，该记录立刻从「最近访问」里移除（⌘K 命令面板、环境首页、本地缓存与服务端 `ui.recent` 偏好同步）。
- 为什么改：删掉的记录还挂在最近访问第一条，点进去落到一条不存在的记录，最近访问越用越不可信。
- 风险与回滚：只加了一个订阅数据源删除事件的监听，只删 `record:对象:ID` 这一条；回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/RecentItemsProvider.tsx`（`useDropDeletedRecordsFromRecents`）→ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx`（唯一挂载点）。
- 两分钟验证：打开一条客户记录 → 更多 → 删除 → 确认，然后按 ⌘K：「最近访问」里不再有它；点 Toast 上的撤销回到该记录后再按 ⌘K，它重新出现在第一条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `useDropDeletedRecordsFromRecents(dataSource)` (new, module-internal to `@object-ui/app-shell`, not exported from the package index): subscribes to the data source's `onMutation` and, on a `delete` event that names its record (`resource` + `id`), calls the provider's existing `removeRecentItem` with the record entry's id, `record:OBJECT:RECORD_ID` (the id the record page writes). `removeRecentItem` already writes the list, localStorage and the debounced `ui.recent` save, and writes nothing when the entry is absent.
- `ConnectedShellInner` mounts it once (`DeletedRecordsLeaveRecents`, beside `UserStateBridge`), on the connected adapter. The console's `ConsoleShell` holds `RecentItemsProvider` above every `ConnectedShell`, so the palette (`CommandPalette`), Home and the sidebar read the trimmed list. One subscriber covers every delete door that reports its record (record header, list row, action) with no call at each door, and `RecordDetailView.tsx` is untouched.
- Undo: the record page's Undo restores the record and navigates back to it; that visit records it again through the record page's existing `addRecentItem` effect. A restore emits no mutation event by design (`restoreRecycleBinEntry`: "a restore is never a create"), so nothing re-inserts the entry before the visit.
- No public surface changes: the `useRecentItems()` value and the package exports are unchanged, so `Clause-②: no` holds.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/RecentItemsProvider.test.tsx` gains one top-level `describe` (the shared harness file): the deleted record leaves the list, localStorage and the saved row; CONTROL another record's delete (same object, other object) leaves it listed and saves nothing; CONTROL an `update` event and an id-less `delete` (bulk) drop nothing; after an undo the revisit lists it again at the head; the listener unsubscribes on unmount.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/ConnectedShell.deletedRecordLeavesRecents-33826.test.tsx` (new): the real `ConnectedShell` under the real recents provider; a delete reported by the adapter drops that record only; the subscription goes away with the shell.
- No forced test edits.

<details><summary>Test runs (head a6cbed12)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/RecentItemsProvider.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/ConnectedShell.deletedRecordLeavesRecents-33826.test.tsx`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 28 passed (28), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed anchor 1 to 0, restored blob == HEAD): `DeletedRecordsLeaveRecents` mount deleted from `ConsoleShell.tsx` turns the shell pin red, Tests 2 failed (2).
- Ablation 2: the `removeRecentItem(recordRecentItemId(...))` call in the hook replaced by a no-op turns 3 pins red (deleted record gone; undo revisit; shell drop), Tests 3 failed / 25 passed (28); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- No build between legs: ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to `src/` through `ui/vitest.config.mts` aliases.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A bulk delete (`bulkDelete`, `bulk('delete')`) emits one resource-level `delete` with no `id`, so its records stay in the recents until opened. Closing it needs the mutation event to carry the deleted ids (`DataSourceMutationEvent` in `@object-ui/types`), a public-type widening outside this card's surface. carrier: seat (named in the report's open_questions).
- A record deleted elsewhere (another session or user) is not reported to this tab's data source, so it stays listed until opened. The card's optional route ("opening a recent whose record answers 404 drops it") lives in the record page's load path (`RecordDetailView.tsx`), which this card's claim fenced off; not done here. carrier: seat.
